entities.summary: Annamaria Solazzi is a female former beach volleyball player from Italy who twice represented her native country at the Summer Olympics: 1996 and 2000. Partnering with Laura Bruschini, she thrice claimed the gold medal at the European Championships: in 1997, 1999 and 2000.
